notes: You need a research project first. The national symposium is April 20 to 24, 2027.
name: Heartland Junior Science and Humanities Symposium (Heartland-JSHS)
city: Iowa City, IA (Iowa and Nebraska students)
what_you_do: Do your own research project. Write a paper about it. If it is picked, present it to judges and compete for scholarships.
who_can_apply: Any high school student in Iowa or Nebraska who is a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident. Your paper must follow the rules in the Iowa Research Handbook. Schools can also bring up to five students to attend without presenting.
pay_detail: Free to enter and attend. Top finalists can win scholarship prizes.
deadline_text: The paper site opens in October 2026. Papers are due January 11, 2027 (11:59 PM Central). You hear back January 25, 2027. Registration is due February 8, 2027.
how_to_apply: Do a research project and write a paper that follows the Iowa Research Handbook. Submit the paper on the program site by the due date. Accepted papers present at the symposium.
